I added `ScoreLabel` (a `Label`) as a direct child of `Main` in `res://main.tscn`, with text "Score: 0" at position (16, 16). I haven't opened the scene in Godot to check it.

The Godot editor wasn't connected, so the gopeak tool call failed. I edited `main.tscn` directly instead, and the change is on disk. I created no other files.

Label is a Control node, so Godot stores its position as offsets in the file. I set `offset_left` and `offset_top` to 16. I also set `offset_right` and `offset_bottom` to 16, which gives the label zero size until Godot sizes it. Godot should resize it to fit the text when the scene loads. If the editor rewrites those two values, the position is unchanged.
